name: weighted kneeling step with swing
description: A kneeling step combined with a weighted swing. It trains the shoulders and core.
instructions: Kneel tall on both knees, holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your hips.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
At the same time, swing the plate up overhead with straight arms.
Lower the plate and bring the foot back to kneeling.
Finish your reps, then step with the other leg.
